ram_single.name: Ram Single
ram_single.note: Prerunner: one fat ram turbine down the hood, ending in a single big up-turned nozzle.

parts.note: jet: fires up, clear of the cab

twin_ram.name: Twin Ram
twin_ram.note: Lifted: two long turbines wide apart and low on the hood, a tall bug-catcher scoop standing between them, two up-turned nozzles at the back.

parts.note: jet: fires up, clear of the cab

slot_scoop.name: Slot Scoop
slot_scoop.note: Minitruck: a flat slot burner lying on the hood under a tall intake scoop. Slot jets down both flanks and one wide slot firing up at the back.

six_pack.name: Six Pack
six_pack.note: Show Truck: a long chrome block with six barrels, three a side, leaning up and out. Six separate jets.

cab_trio.name: Trio
cab_trio.note: Cab: a short pack of three at the very nose. One turbine leads, two sit back beside it, and three up-turned nozzles stand in a row behind them. The hood behind is bare.

parts.note: jet: fires up, clear of the cab
jet: fires up, clear of the cab

doghouse.name: Doghouse
doghouse.note: Courier: a low engine cover hard against the cab, open at the front. A slim turbine barrel runs out of it to a round intake at the nose. Two up-turned nozzles stand in tandem on the lid.

parts.note: doghouse: low engine cover against the cab
open mouth of the cover: the barrel comes out here
turbine barrel, running out of the cover
round intake bell at the nose
jet: fires up, clear of the cab
jet: fires up, clear of the cab

bed_turbine.name: Bed Turbine
bed_turbine.note: Prerunner: one huge turbine lying in the bed.

twin_barrels.name: Twin Barrels
twin_barrels.note: Lifted: two long, low turbines set wide apart against the bed sides, ram scoops on top.

deck_burner.name: Deck Burner
deck_burner.note: Minitruck: a low, wide slot burner on the deck with a bright turbine hump down its dark body. The slot nozzle is raised at the tail, edged in neon, and glows full width.

parts.note: flat burner body: dark, so it reads on a bright deck
body rim plate: outlines the burner on a dark deck
turbine hump, standing out of the burner

quad_chrome.name: Quad Chrome
quad_chrome.note: Show Truck: four short chrome turbines in a 2 x 2 block at the tail, fed by a tall plenum.

over_under.name: Over-Under
over_under.note: Cab: two turbines stacked. The lower runs the length of the bed, the upper is a short one set right back.

tail_three.name: Tail Three
tail_three.note: Courier: three short turbines side by side on the tail deck, fed by one intake trunk that runs forward into the box.

parts.note: intake box at the front of the bed

long_travel.name: Long Travel
long_travel.note: Prerunner: long nacelle pods far out on A-arms and coil-overs, two down-jets each.

stilts.name: Stilts
stilts.note: Lifted: tall thruster legs on outrigger beams. The longest reach: the highest ride.

tucked_slots.name: Tucked Slots
tucked_slots.note: Minitruck: flat slot-jet pods tucked in under the body. The shortest reach: the lowest ride.

dually_vectors.name: Dually Vectors
dually_vectors.note: Show Truck: two chrome vectoring nozzles side by side at each corner.

spats.name: Jet Racks
spats.note: Cab: a jet rack. Three down nozzles in a row stand below a short vented skirt, with an intake grille and a glow slot on its outer face.

parts.note: jet rack housing: jet hardware, not an arch
intake grille on the outer face
jet rack housing: jet hardware, not an arch
intake grille on the outer face

box_lifts.name: Box Lifts
box_lifts.note: Courier: one square lift duct at each corner, flat and boxy, with a grille on top and a square jet underneath.

parts.note: square lift duct, longer than wide
square lift duct, longer than wide

side_dumps.name: Side Dumps
side_dumps.note: Prerunner: two fat afterburner cans a side, stacked low behind the cab, filling the dump bay and kicked outboard.

parts.note: boost jet: fires back and outboard
boost jet: fires back and outboard

shorty_stacks.name: Shorty Stacks
shorty_stacks.note: Lifted: four fat shorty stacks, two each side, stepped.

tail_slot.name: Tail Slots
tail_slot.note: Minitruck: one flat duckbill burner on each bed tail corner, low on the deck line. A body-colour root, a wide flat bill with a neon lip and a glow strip 2 wide.

parts.note: burner root on the flank port, body colour, narrow
throat: the bill fans out from the root
boost jet: a flat slot 2 wide

chrome_stacks.name: Chrome Stacks
chrome_stacks.note: Show Truck: two tall chrome stacks behind the cab with heat shields.

tail_cans.name: Tail Cans
tail_cans.note: Cab: four round afterburner cans, two side by side on each bed tail corner, the outer one longer. Body colour with a neon band, no shroud.

parts.note: afterburner can, body colour, longer than wide, high on the flank port
afterburner can, body colour, longer than wide, high on the flank port

fishtails.name: Fishtails
fishtails.note: Courier: one pipe a side rising behind the cab into a wide flat fishtail. A slot jet across the top of each blade.

parts.note: elbow out of the bed side at deck height
riser pipe: nothing below the deck line
boost jet: a slot across the fishtail

flare_nose.name: Flare Nose
flare_nose.note: Prerunner: a thin shell held high over the bare frame. Fenders slope from the cowl deck to a beak, a full-width skid plate kicks up to the nose under it, wide flares cover the lift jets.

smoothie.note: Minitruck: low droop-snoot. A narrow body and a long thin prow that stands well forward of the corners. The hood falls away from a wide cowl deck. No arches.
